lines: Aanya heads to the quiet library courtyard, holding a smooth gray pebble that brings her peace.
She notices the crossing light blinks only three times instead of four, breaking the street's usual rhythm.
When the next signal fails even faster, she pulls her friend Toby back from a speeding car.
She warns the crossing guard about the failing pattern, but he brushes her math aside.
Using her love of numbers, she calculates exactly when the busiest crossing will go completely dark.
She builds a cardboard model with flashing lights to show the adults the dangerous pattern she sees.
The light fails exactly as predicted, and she stops Toby from stepping in front of a truck.
With everyone safe, Aanya finally places her smooth pebble on the quiet library bench, her pattern complete.
